observations.observation: The commission names a path-scope guard that must fail CI for writes outside the allowlist, but the seeded tree at the branch point contained no such guard. The mandatory control was absent, not merely weak.
No PO-01 branch, path or artifact exists at this head, so PO-01 reproduction and non-interference are vacuous rather than satisfied.

The governance estate holds 184 files across the scanned directories, of which only 15 are reachable from the two current pointers and 136 carry no supersession marker at all. The dominant state of the estate is unclassified rather than either current or superseded.
Six files that the current pointers route to also contain the string SUPERSEDED within their first 2KB, so a purely textual supersession heuristic would mark live routing targets as dead.
No agent-dispatch capability is exposed to this worker, so the commission's concurrency, scale and cross-family review instructions were unreachable rather than declined.
The published JSON Schemas declared additionalProperties:false while the executable validator accepted unknown fields, so the enforced contract was more permissive than the documented one.

challenges.challenge: Is 64 work units the real requirement, or is the real requirement durable independently checkable results?
challenges.conclusion: The commission's own definition excludes renamed clones, inventories and duplicated summaries from the count. Ten genuine units were executed and the 64-unit target was recorded NOT_YET rather than satisfied by padding.

challenges.challenge: Does a passing changed-path guard actually prove no write escaped the allowlist?
challenges.conclusion: No. Rename detection hid a deletion outside the allowlist, and the guard still passes vacuously on an empty diff. One hole was closed; the other is disclosed as residual risk.

challenges.challenge: Does a manifest of the subtree prove the subtree's contents?
challenges.conclusion: Not while symlinks are followed. A tracked symlink made the manifest assert coverage of bytes outside the subtree, so non-regular git modes are now refused.

challenges.challenge: Can this Wave claim compounding lift from G0 to G1?
challenges.conclusion: No. The added tests were written by the same producer as the code they exercise, so counting them as a score would measure test volume, not capability. Lift is recorded NOT_YET and only a capability delta is claimed.

challenges.challenge: Should PO-03 self-mark any unit accepted, given no reviewer was reachable?
challenges.conclusion: No. Every unit remains NOT_TESTED or PENDING and a repository-wide gate now fails if any committed document grants itself acceptance.

reproductions.detail: An invented top-level field validated successfully before the change despite additionalProperties:false in the schema.
A tracked symlink produced a manifest digest equal to the sha256 of a file outside the subtree.
git mv of a governance file into the allowlist produced a diff naming only the destination, so the guard passed while a file outside the allowlist was deleted.
Nine result documents were generated from blobs read at their recorded commits and all nine validate; independently recomputed input and acceptance hashes matched the recorded metrics exactly.
Self-acceptance is rejected per document and a repository-wide scan finds no self-granted acceptance in any committed record.
Seven event records carry unique ids and contiguous sequence numbers, and the gate fails on any gap or duplicate.

live_mechanism_changes.change: The CI changed-path base now resolves against the PO-03 base ref before falling back to origin/main, so the guard no longer fails on pre-existing base-branch content.
Both CI diff invocations pass --no-renames, so a rename out of the allowlist can no longer hide a deletion.
The manifest refuses git modes 120000 and 160000 and refuses to hash symlinks, so it cannot import content from outside the subtree it describes.
The executable validator now rejects unknown keys at every closed object, and a schema-agreement test asserts its key sets equal the published JSON Schema properties.

Anti-fabrication gates now assert that every 40-hex commit id in the PO-03 records resolves to a real commit, that every frozen source hash matches the bytes at the branch point, that every artifact hash matches its committed blob, and that every test cited in the evidence actually exists.

independent_tests.note: Independent recurrence testing by a reviewer who did not write these repairs is NOT_YET; no cross-family reviewer was reachable this session.
